privacy.title: Data & Privacy
privacy.intro: Essential account, security and Gold data is processed when you use those features. Optional analytics is off unless you enable it.
privacy.analyticsDesc: If enabled, Google Analytics receives an app-instance ID, listening/channel and session activity, app/device information, approximate location derived from masked IP, and optional age range/gender. No account name, email, advertising ID or precise location. Google is a third-party recipient.
privacy.demographicsDesc: Optional. Helps us understand who listens.
privacy.essentialNotice: Essential processing is separate from optional consent. See the Privacy Notice for controller identity, purposes, legal bases, recipients, retention and your rights.
privacy.termsNote: Use of this app requires the Terms of Use. Analytics and demographics remain optional and can be withdrawn later.
privacy.termsAcceptance: I accept the Terms of Use.
